entities.summary: Tsougria, Tsoungria, or Tsougkria is a Greek island in the western part of the Sporades archipelago. As of 2011, it had no resident population, as it is a protected natural habitat. It is administratively part of the municipality of Skiathos and is located southeast of the island. The island has several beaches that are popular with yachts and round-island trips.
